row.observed_excerpt: ... والصنبور: مثعب الحوض خاصة ; حكاه أبو عبيد . وأنشد : ما بين صنبور إلى الإزاء ...

bounded_question: Does an edition-identified early print witness preserve the same lexical report, while keeping the direct Abu Ubayd source claim distinct?

source_anchors.work: al-Jawhari, al-Sihah, Bulaq printing 1282 AH / 1865, vol. 1
source_anchors.machine_reading: The page transcription reads: فعب الحوض خاصة حكاه أبو عبيد وأنشد مابين صنبور الى الازاء والصنبور صبة تكون فى الاداوة من حديد أورصاص يشرب منها
source_anchors.exact_target: مثعب الحوض خاصة حكاه أبو عبيد
source_anchors.surrounding_entry: The next definition in the same transcription describes a tube in a water vessel made of iron or lead.
limitations: This is OCR from the page image and has not been visually checked in this run.

The museum states its machine reading was uncorrected; in a sample of six lines, roughly one word in five had a wrong or split letter. It specifically directs readers to check relied-upon words against the scan.
The OCR snippet begins with an apparent recognition error around مثعب; therefore do not normalize or claim diplomatic transcription from OCR alone.

source_anchors.locator: Digital display vol. 2, p. 272, fasl al-sad; imprint page identifies editor Ahmad Abd al-Ghafur Attar and Dar al-Ilm lil-Malayin, Beirut, but not year/edition number.
source_anchors.wording: الصنبور: مثعب الحوض خاصة، حكاه أبو عبيد وأنشد
source_anchors.limitation: Print edition identity and image check remain unresolved; do not equate it with the Bulaq scan or the second Attar edition.

source_anchors.edition: First edition, Hyderabad Deccan, 1384 AH / 1964, series 92/2, part 1.
source_anchors.prior_bounded_result: The exact phrase مثعب الحوض خاصة was not found in the inspected entry; other senses including a vessel tube are recorded. This does not prove it is absent elsewhere in Abu Ubayd's corpus.

source_anchors.wording: وقيل : هو مثعب الحوض خاصة ; حكاه أبو عبيد . وأنشد : ما بين صنبور إلى الإزاء
source_anchors.role: Qurtubi reports an attributed lexical gloss. This sentence does not provide an oral transmission chain.

findings.confirmed_with_locus: An Islam Museum machine-reading record for the Bulaq 1282 AH / 1865 al-Sihah, vol. 1, scan p. 296 (printed p. 345), places the special cistern gloss and Abu Ubayd attribution in the same lexicographic entry; a second digital al-Sihah text presents the same report.
findings.evidential_boundary: This supports the existence of an al-Jawhari witness for the reported gloss, but because the Bulaq OCR was not visually checked, it remains a transcription-level corroboration, not verified page-image transcription.
findings.authorship_boundary: The lexicographic text says al-Jawhari reports the gloss as حكاه أبو عبيد. It does not itself make that passage a direct witness from Abu Ubayd.
findings.independence: No evidence establishes that Qurtubi independently consulted this al-Jawhari text rather than a shared source or another transmission of the gloss.
